tools.description: Inspect a Source Trail under fresh authorization for its configured source. Returns filtered historical metadata, never evidence text. Denial releases no historical payload. An opted-in call also returns the supersession consultation the trail recorded.

retrieval_details.description: Return verified producing vector/hybrid identities, coverage and ranking facts when recorded. No search is rerun; historical completeness is not inferred from today's index. Omitted or false keeps the default inspection.

supersession.description: Return the consultation the trail recorded: consulted state, nullable activation/declaration identities and exact withholding rows. Present only for v4, lexical token/supersession v8, byte vector/hybrid v9 or token vector/hybrid v10 history. Reports producing evidence, not today's activation projection; omitted or false hides it.

token_details.description: Return the verified accepted-candidate token selection recorded by v7, v8 or v10. Counts are producing observations; no tokenizer runs or recounts. Omitted or false hides token facts.
